description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to property of intestate in Marahela, Minuwangoda D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510405 and to 17 other properties
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically notices calling for claims to intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land information including parcel numbers, extents, cadastral maps, and registration details for multiple properties. The content focuses on land title settlement and property inheritance claims, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
